answer: Make every new identity finish a verifiable delay function before it can vote: a strictly sequential computation that takes about 30 days on one fast thread and cannot be parallelized, yet anyone can check the proof in a second. Admission becomes a slow voyage that money cannot shorten, so an attacker wanting 1,000 clones must keep 1,000 cores busy for a month, roughly $15,000 in rented compute. Finished proofs earn a violet badge, and each badge is bound to one thread of signed history.
